description: Create a new plot and make it the current (i.e., active) plot. If no name is specified, one is assigned by default.

python_sdk_alternative.workaround: itasca.command('plot create <name>') - no direct Python SDK method

keywords.name: s
keywords.description: Name for the new plot, as a quoted string (e.g. 'myplot') or a positive integer. A bare unquoted word is rejected with 'Unused extra parameter' - the parser expects 'Name (string or positive integer)'. If not specified, a default name is assigned.

examples.description: Create a new plot with a default name

Verified in PFC2D 7.0 (2026-08): 'plot create test_view' (unquoted) fails; 'plot create 'test_view'' and 'plot create 5' succeed and the plot is immediately addressable as plot '<name>' (e.g. plot 'test_view' view ?) and removable with plot '<name>' delete.
